description: O7 atomic-axis typing + residual-default detection for every multi-leaf subheading (>=2 tariff_lines). For each sub: the discriminating concept-axes (un-fused from the TLA arrays + leaf descriptions), each axis = {axis,label,values_present,value_to_codes}; residual catch-all flag + code; and a classification (residual_default | askable_no_residual | single_axis_resolved | untypable). Derived build-time from tariff_lines + tariff_line_attributes (no Gemini); see DERIVATION.md. Loaded at runtime by lib/atomic-axis-table.ts. This is the structural foundation the S4 divergence engine uses to ask ONE clean question per axis and to know when NOT to ask (residual_default / untypable).
